source.note: 2001-02 Fleer Shoebox basketball hobby product. TCDB lists a 180-card base set, 11 insert sets and two parallels. This VCS bundle models the hobby issue only: Footprints Retail and the single promo card are excluded. Pack/box configuration and published insertion rates were cross-checked against hobby box listings.

decisions.baseStructure: #1-180. Cards #1-150 are veterans; #151-180 are recognized true rookie cards serial numbered to 2500.
decisions.baseRookieModeling: The current VCS engine has one BASE ProductSet and cannot enforce a separate scarcity rate for #151-180. All 180 cards remain in Base; RC and SN2500 are preserved per card. Product remains unreleased until pricing/odds are reviewed.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Append RC to the player/name field only for recognized true rookie cards. For this set TCDB identifies all 30 cards #151-180 as RCs. The RC designation is carried into the hobby Footprints parallel derived from Base.
decisions.hobbyOnly: Footprints Retail and the Vince Carter promo are excluded because this Product represents the hobby box configuration.
decisions.nnoHandling: TCDB memorabilia/checklist cards that are all numbered NNO receive deterministic synthetic VCS card numbers (NNO-01, NNO-02, etc.) so card numbers remain unique within each ProductSet. Printed NNO status is retained in variant metadata.
decisions.oddsModeling: Only directly published insertion rates are encoded: NBA Flight School 1:12, NBA Flight School Cadet 1:63, Sole of the Game 1:144, Tougher Than Leather 1:36. Serial-only memorabilia tiers and Footprints retain serial metadata with oddsPerPack null rather than inferring odds from print runs.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased because the base RC serial-number scarcity is not representable separately inside one BASE ProductSet, several memorabilia families have shared box-level rather than set-specific odds, and pricing/images remain pending.
